name: MCB 5284
title: Current Topics in Cell and Developmental Biology
description: Reading and discussion of papers from the recent literature. Topics include cytoskeletal function, cell motility, gene expression, and signal transduction, with special focus on their relationship to development, host-pathogen interactions, the immune system, and cancer. May be repeated for a total of six credits. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
